chapters.title: Chapter I — The Opening Bell
prose: Ten fighters walked in on the same morning with the same rules.
The board sorted itself with unusual honesty.

chapters.title: Chapter II — The Bar Falls
prose: Two names dropped below the line and the ledger wrote two lines.

chapters.title: This chapter is dropped: no day, no prose worth the name
Chapter III — New Blood
prose: Two strangers at the door, unrated at fifty.
Nothing is owed to you here.
